unresolved_this_pass: deployment topology: Docker stack vs desktop app vs hybrid
harness acquisition: BYO volume mount vs agent-manager install vs prebaked images
state persistence across image updates (volume layout, schema migrations, worktrees on bind mounts)
forgo-BYO-agent and hand-build harness configs (BYOK + curated agents) — viability
LLM API management: external gateway (LiteLLM/BiFrost/OmniRoute) vs bundled vs integrated
model-to-agent assignment: preset tiers vs user assignment vs auto-routing
pi vs opencode as specialist RolePack substrate; pi.dev/packages ecosystem
coding standards enforcement: LSPs, hooks, lefthook, static analysis (semgrep/sonar/linters/formatters)

entities: Deployment Unit (desktop binary / container stack / hybrid worker image)
Harness Distro (installed CLI harness + its config dir + its auth material)
Auth Material (OAuth session vs API key vs subscription entitlement) — never a raw token in an agent context
State Volume (what survives image updates: config, auth, sqlite, worktrees, caches, logs)
Model Namespace (provider profile -> model id -> role binding)
RolePack (versioned agent template: system prompt + skills + MCP slice + model binding + harness profile)
Quality Gate Stack (agent-loop / pre-commit / pre-push / merge-queue / CI)
Diagnostic Broker (LSP -> SARIF/structured findings -> agent feedback channel)
Anti-circumvention Guard (agents may not weaken lint/config/ignore/baseline)
constraints: local-first: user's code and OAuth material stay on user hardware by default
agents never see raw OAuth tokens — capability handles only (already shipped in roles/)
state must survive harness and image churn without re-login and without volume drift
quality gates must be fail-closed and non-bypassable by the agent under test
memory must be structured-first; vector index stays opt-in with mandatory reranker (prior pass)
no marketplace / cloud-hosting / mobile scope creep in the next phase (roadmap boundary)
coordination overhead must not dominate token budget
